name: compare_traces
description: Compare two Perfetto traces side-by-side and produce a performance delta report. Extracts frame timing, top expensive slices, and thread utilization from both traces. Use get_traces to find available session IDs. Useful for before/after optimization comparisons.

baseline_id.description: Session ID of the baseline trace (before optimization). Use get_traces to find available session IDs.

comparison_id.description: Session ID of the comparison trace (after optimization). Use get_traces to find available session IDs.
